name: Volumetric Surfaces
definition: A representation for real-time view synthesis that models objects as semi-transparent multi-layer meshes rendered in a fixed order to efficiently represent fuzzy geometries while bounding sampling locations and eliminating sorting overhead.
summary: Volumetric Surfaces is a real-time view synthesis method that represents fuzzy geometries as semi-transparent multi-layer meshes, eliminating sorting overhead for efficient hardware-accelerated rendering.
